verdict.line: You lose if you let Parrrley and poison chip you down from range all lane; you win if you force stationary all-ins while Remove Scurvy is on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's threat is entirely ranged: Parrrley at 625 range plus poison-stacking autos let him zone Sett without ever entering punch range. Sett has no dash or gap closer, so this matchup is decided by whether he can convert E (Facebreaker) pulls into committed trades before chip damage adds up, not by trying to out-poke him. The data backs an even read — 49.3% over 272 games — with Sett carrying the solo-kill edge once he closes the distance.

theirWindow.when: Parrrley up, you're in his 625 range
theirWindow.what: He free-pokes with Q and lets poison tick on any auto trade. Don't walk forward to contest cs or stand in open range without a minion wave to break his line.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in. Commit E (Facebreaker) for the stun — it can't be cleansed right now — and follow with R (The Show Stopper) if he's isolated from his wave.

powerCurve.note: no gap closer, eats free poke
Stridebreaker closes gaps, trades stay close

start.why: The flat HP and regen offset poison ticks and Parrrley chip so you can stay in lane range instead of being zoned off minions.

boots.why: Cuts the physical damage from his autos and Parrrley, which is most of his early harass since his poison is the only magic component.

core.why: The active gives you the closing speed you otherwise lack against a champion with no reason to stand still.
Shred helps your all-in windows do real damage once you've forced the stun.
Tankiness to survive extended poison stacking while you close distance repeatedly.

situational.when: fights are turning into prolonged skirmishes and you need burst mitigation on the way in
the lane stalemates and poison/poke chip damage is wearing down your sustain over time
you're ahead and want to siege, since his poke is strong defensively but weak against a split push

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks build through the poke you're forced to eat and through your committed trades, giving sustain against the poison DoT and eventual true damage once you're locked into an all-in.

summoners.why: Ignite is the real tech here: Remove Scurvy heals him out of your all-in, but Ignite's damage can't be cleansed and the grievous wounds cuts that heal down when it matters most.

playing.title: Track Remove Scurvy, not his HP
playing.detail: His W clears CC and heals on an 18-22s cooldown depending on rank. Committing E or R while it's up just wastes your engage — wait for it to be down.

playing.title: Don't facecheck Parrrley range
playing.detail: 625 range plus poison stacking on any auto means walking up without wave cover is a free loss. Stay behind or beside minions until you're ready to commit.

playing.title: Pop Q while closing, not after
playing.detail: Knuckle Down's move speed bonus only triggers while moving toward champions, so cast it as you're approaching through his poke, not once you're already in range.

playing.title: Save R for isolated picks
playing.detail: The Show Stopper is 120/100/80/80/80s — don't burn it mid-trade. Reserve it for moments he's pushed away from his wave, since dragging him off minions denies his Parrrley gold refund entirely.

playing.title: Commit through the stun, not around it
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns if he's pulled from both sides — if he's alone on one side it's just a slow. Position so you catch him between you and a minion or wall before casting.

playing.title: Finish trades once Ignite is on
playing.detail: After E lands, drop Ignite immediately — it denies the Remove Scurvy heal that's his only way out of your all-in.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, win rates, and rune/summoner pick rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown-window reasoning and trade pattern calls are my own read on the ability kit.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Gangplank’s Grasp of the Undying – (Q) combo. Use [E] when his (W) is on cooldown to follow up with [R] when dealing damage.
